lore.huntlike.animal.1: Evolution's biggest galliforme. It hunted everything from small bugs to small reptiles, and hunted in packs to bring down bigger prey. When the food supply ran out, the species went extinct, and its spirit was taken into the unknown territory.
lore.huntlike.animal.2: Long ago, a herd of hylochoerus lived carelessly on an island called Nebrosa, worshipped by a tribe called the Poquao. The Poquao spent all their resources feeding the herd and building a temple that never worked. Within a few years, they all starved.
lore.huntlike.animal.3: Ammon was born in a starving village destined to disappear. Through magic, he spoke with the deities of the unknown territory and became the first known human hunter. Hunting filled every plate of the village, and the hunters he taught kept the village alive against its fate. When a monstrous sheep finally slew him, the village named the species Ovis Ammon in his honor. Centuries later, the Egyptians found depictions of him and declared him a horned god of creation.
lore.huntlike.animal.4: There are depictions of aurochs in millennia-old caves, drawn with blood of animal origin. On further investigation, the species was traced back to a massive cave, in which a type of cave moss was found. The moss kept the cows from leaving by keeping them fed and safe from predators of the surface. Scientists attempted to investigate where the cave moss came from, realizing it was more than just food for the cows. The moss had ultra-high levels of nutrients and calories, being an aliment that could be consumed in low quantities and keep species fed for a day or two. On a later expedition to the cave, a hunter noticed a strong magical power coming from the moss.
lore.huntlike.animal.5: The epicyon haydeni belonged to the bone-crushing dogs: gigantic canines of the wild that hunted alone and became the apex predators of their ecosystems. They went extinct from a lack of food, as faster feline species reached the prey first and left them starving. Yggard, a scientist, paleontologist and hunter, declared that the species' bones held a strong magical connection with natural objects, hinting at a rapid evolution and a golden age planned by a deity to prevent some sort of catastrophe. For this reason, it is theorized that the species was sent to the unknown territory.

lore.huntlike.cluster.1: Stories read of overslimes, slimes of terrible size that rule over other slimes. Cubert was one of the biggest overslimes of all time, but recently, around 30 years ago, a hunter fought with it and split it in much smaller fragments of itself.
lore.huntlike.cluster.2: It is known between metalworkers that when a slime consumes iron it turns it into slimysteel, being a lighter and softer material that provides the sharpness of the very metal it consumes. Finding slimysteel producing slimes is hard, and so is doing it by hand, so slime as a resource hasn't been explored too much yet.
lore.huntlike.cluster.3: A conflict is marked on caves, one that involves an extinct race of clusters that scientists like Yggard call soul clusters. Soul clusters are powerful clusters immune to temperatures and capable of super efficient regeneration. The conflict itself depicted slimes leaving the overworld through an obsidian portal similar to the Nether portal, just to come back years later, adapted to just withstand heat. The conflict ended in that same encounter, as both sides wanted peace and union. One race stayed in the Overworld and the other one in the Nether.
lore.huntlike.cluster.4: There are traces of intermixed clusters that lived around a century after the soul cluster conflict, most of the species perished. The only species that had recent traces were demi-soul clusters, with registered marks found by analyzing certain ecosystems. Some years ago, a huge group of demi-soul clusters were found on an island called Nebrosa, they were all resting week long naps and depending on the small pigs of the island as a food supply for both the pig waste and the pigs themselves. The pigs of the island had an overpopulation issue, as it is registered that they were much bigger in the past and consumed around three times the food. The overpopulation problem somehow even extended into the Nether, as connected Nether regions present an overpopulation of pigmen as well.
lore.huntlike.cluster.5: One sub-species of soul clusters stood out, one that adapts their core to the temperature it needs to resist. The sub-species was deemed turpe gelatinosum, the vile gelatinous, as most traces of the species were found near groups of weak cluster beings. The sub-species invented a dialect that was solved in no time, and on a cave their intentions were literally set in stone. The species wanted to take over other clusters and consume them for power. One day, a renowned soul cluster named King Colossus because of his power and kind nature, decimated around a 95% of the species, the missing 5% were never found by Colossus.
